question: Which GST thin film in the Sn-incorporated GST terahertz study had the highest conductivity at 1 THz, and what power was its Sn target sputtered at?
rendered: According to Table 1 in the document, the Sn-incorporated GST thin film with the highest conductivity at 1 THz was Sn24W-GST-250, which had a conductivity of 17928.63 S/m. The Sn target was sputtered at 24 W.
